shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
radiating fan- or plant-like motif with fronds
curved, hook or scroll-like linear motifs
band-like register of repeated elements along the upper part
justification: Both surfaces carry carved profile creatures alongside a radiating frond-like or fan-shaped motif, and both organise some content into an upper band of repeated elements, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a shallow, fine incised horizontal panel of dense, interlocking curvilinear line-work with a symmetrical central splay, while B is a tall vertical block with bold, rounded, sculptural relief figures stacked in discrete registers against plain ground.
